artworks.title: Reynard and the Rabbit
artworks.description: The image is an illustration of a countryside scene featuring a hare and a fox in the foreground. There are trees and a hill with a castle-like structure in the distance. A horse-drawn carriage with figures is seen on the horizon. The sky shows light clouds. The artwork uses a black and white color palette with detailed line work and cross-hatching to create texture and depth.

artworks.title: Reynard Describes the Missing Treasures
artworks.description: The image displays two lions at rest and a fox standing nearby. Closest to the viewer are intricately crafted foliage and grass, with a horizon line above the lions' heads. In the background, trees and mountains give a sense of depth. On the right are empty frames on the ground. The artwork uses a monochrome palette with fine etching techniques for light and shadow contrast, enhancing texture and depth.

artworks.title: The Horse and the Stag
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with animals and a person. The view is slightly elevated, showing trees and foliage blocking most of the horizon. There are sheep, goats, and a horse near us, with a person wearing a hat holding the horse's reins. The animals and details are depicted with fine lines. Deer can be seen in the distance among sparse trees. The trees extend across the scene, with light foliage against the sky. The color palette is monochrome with black and white creating contrast.

artworks.title: The Horse Forced to Pursue the Stag
artworks.description: The image displays an etched scene featuring a group of sheep and a goat resting on grass. In the background, a rider on horseback jumps over a log. Trees are densely packed along the low horizon. The scene is depicted in black and white, with fine lines and detailed textures. The etching technique creates an intricate and visually engaging composition, emphasizing the central action of the rider and horse.

artworks.title: The Ass and the Hound
artworks.description: This is an image of a hybrid creature dancing. The scene depicts a lion-headed human-like creature and an anthropomorphic donkey figure dancing together. In the background, there are ships and humanoid figures handling barrels. On the right, there is a gathering with people wearing hats, and in the foreground, a small lion or large dog is present. The backdrop includes a large Gothic-style building. The overall scene conveys a sense of a bustling port town with fantastical elements.

artworks.title: Reynard's Father and the Cat Pursued by Hounds
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a wooded scene with several animals. In the image, there is a large tree with a sturdy trunk and sprawling branches, set in a forested area. On one of the branches, a small animal is perched, while four dogs are positioned below, looking up at the tree. The background shows more trees and a pathway where two figures are visible in the distance. The drawing features detailed rendering of the tree bark, foliage, and textured ground, suggesting a scene full of life and activity, capturing a moment of nature involving animals and humans within a forest setting. The style is reminiscent of classical etchings with fine line work and shading.

artworks.title: The Wolf and the Crane
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a fox and a crane interacting. The image shows a fox seated on the ground with its mouth open wide, while a crane uses its long beak to interact with the fox. The setting is outdoors with lush foliage, grasses, distant mountains, and a cloudy sky in the background. The drawing includes detailed elements like the texture of the fox's fur, the feathers of the crane, and the branches and leaves of surrounding trees.

artworks.title: The Wolves on the Ice
artworks.description: The image is viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is in the middle, with a line of bare trees and a windmill to the left. The land close to us is detailed, and the sky above is expansive. The image uses fine lines typical of etching, with cross-hatching for texture. The color palette is monochromatic in sepia and black. Two foxes are close to us, one alert and the other startled in grass and trees. In the distance, small figures walk on ice or snow near the windmill.

artworks.title: The Wolf and the Well
artworks.description: The image shows a scene from an elevated point of view. The horizon is not clearly defined, enveloped in dark tones. On the left, there is a silhouette of a building with a tower. In the center, a well with a bucket hoisted above it is visible, and a fox is on the stone rim to the right. The artwork uses soft brushstrokes to create deep shades and textures. Dark browns and earthy tones dominate the color palette, with light highlighting the fox and the well. The details are rich, especially in the fox's fur and tree foliage, while the surroundings fade into obscurity, enhancing the mystery.

artworks.title: The Wolf and the Monkeys
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a fox and two monkeys in a rocky landscape. The fox is on the left facing the monkeys on the right. One monkey is seated with a thoughtful expression, and the other monkey is looking towards the fox. Trees are in the background, with detailed line shading on the rocky terrain. Branches with leaves create a boundary around the scene.

artworks.title: Reynard Blinds the Wolf in One Eye
artworks.description: A drawing of several animals in a scenic landscape. The animals depicted include a lion, a ram or sheep, a rooster, and a fox. The landscape features a large tree on the left, rolling hills, mountain peaks in the middle ground, and a castle-like structure in the distance to the right. The artwork is done in an etching technique, emphasizing the texture of fur and foliage. The scene has a classic quality, with the animals appearing to interact in a storybook manner.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Reynard
artworks.description: This is an image of animals in a forest setting. It features a fox sitting on a donkey, with a bear and a canine-like creature nearby. The background shows lush foliage and trees, with mountains in the distance. The animals and environment are detailed with skillful line work and shading.

artworks.title: The Assumption of the Virgin
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple figures in a celestial setting. The scene features figures floating amidst swirling clouds. The central figure is surrounded by smaller cherubic forms with wings and drapery, interacting with the central figure. The clouds are depicted with fluid lines, creating depth and movement. The intricate linework and ethereal quality suggest a focus on spirituality and divine interaction.

artworks.title: Saint James Defeating the Infidels
artworks.medium: black chalk with brown wash squared with black chalk
artworks.description: This is a drawing of horses in motion. The composition features swirling forms and indications of movement. In the center, there is a prominent horse and a figure. Surrounding them are several other horses in various poses. The drawing is overlaid with a grid pattern. Dark tones and bold lines are used to depict energy and drama.

artworks.title: Peasants and Cattle near a Farmhouse
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper

artworks.title: Figures Bathing in a Stream
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene with trees, clouds, figures, rocks, vegetation, and a stream. The artwork is sketched with fine lines, soft shading, and warm sepia tones, creating depth and texture.

artworks.title: Saint Catherine in the Clouds
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright. They are looking slightly upwards with their head turned to the left. The person has curly hair and a determined expression. They are wearing flowing garments that appear to be moving, and are holding a feather in their left hand and a sword in their right hand pointed towards the ground. The background is simple, with radiant lines behind the person's head.

artworks.title: Study for "La Cuisine Avec Paisans"
artworks.medium: red and black chalk on gray laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures: an adult male playing a bagpipe, an adult female standing beside him, and a small child next to her. An additional small animal-like figure is at the bottom.

artworks.title: Study of a Nude Old Woman Clenching Her Fists, and Two Decorative Objects
artworks.medium: black and blue crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a figure in a crouched or kneeling position with the head lowered and arm resting on the knee. The figure's body is outlined with pencil strokes, emphasizing the muscular structure and posture. Facial features are not detailed. The figure appears unclothed. To the right are abstract sketches of geometrical shapes and forms. The background is plain sketch paper, and the artist's signature, "Gustav Klimt," is at the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Seated Nude with Drapery
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash heightened with white over touches of black chalk on paper washed brown
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Malcolm W. Bick
artworks.description: The image depicts a person seated with their body turned and their face looking over their shoulder. The person's facial features are softly outlined, with an oval face and a relatively simple expression. The person's hair is styled in soft, short curls or waves. They are draped in a loose, flowing garment that covers their lower body, with their upper torso exposed. A visible arm with a pointed hand is reaching towards the seated person. The background is a plain, textured surface.

artworks.title: Birds - U.S.P.R.R. Exp. & Surveys, 35th Parallel
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of birds perched on a branch. The drawing features two main images of birds alongside additional illustrations showing detailed aspects of the birds. The birds are depicted in a realistic and detailed manner. Fig. 1a and Fig. 2 show two positions of the same species on branches, one facing left and the other right. Fig. 1b provides a detailed illustration of the tail feathers. Fig. 3 and Fig. 4 are detailed headshots that emphasize the sharp beak and expressive eyes of the bird. The title at the top mentions "Birds - Plate XXXII" and organizational details.

artworks.title: The Alpine Vulture
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of a vulture perched on a rock. The vulture has a large, hooked beak and yellow eyes. Its head and neck have light feathers, while its body is dark brown with hints of gold on the wings and tail. The vulture is standing on a flat rock surrounded by grass. This painting is in the style of 18th century ornithological illustrations.

artworks.title: Bird (Larvivora Ruficeps)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bird called Larvivora ruficeps. The illustration shows a bird with a red-brown head, a black mask around its eyes, and a white throat. It has a dark upper body blending into grayish tones on the underparts. The bird is standing on the ground among grasses and fallen leaves in a naturalistic habitat.
